correctness.rationale: Every exact-degree spherical harmonic on the normalized d-cube has Walsh parity and support-size restrictions. The proof constructs explicit harmonic witnesses for every nonempty proper Walsh component (products of two-variable harmonic powers with disjoint multilinear factors), treats the constant component separately, and shows the top alternating character at degree d+2 is absent because its sign projection is product(x_i)*sum(a_i*x_i²) with sum a_i=0 by harmonicity. This proves rank sum_{j<=min(d,k),j≡k mod2} binom(d,j) minus the k=2 and k=d+2 exceptions for every d>=3 and 0<=k<=d+2, unique top Walsh annihilator and regression after full rank. Independent exact Gegenbauer/Krawtchouk rank calculation for d=3..6 and all listed degrees agreed; finite ranks alone are not an all-d proof.
